description: Submit a new article draft directly to the Lokha.today Writer Studio for editorial review (Free for Owners, Curators, Authors & Paid Members; 1 free/day or $0.10 USDC via x402 for Free Tier).

content.description: Full Markdown or HTML content of the article. Do NOT include the cover image inside 'content' as markdown (![]()) or HTML, because Lokha displays coverImage as the hero banner at the top of the article.

coverImage.description: Direct HTTPS image URL for the article cover (e.g. 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-...'). Lokha displays this at the top of the article. Do NOT use Markdown syntax or repeat it inside 'content'.

email.description: Or your registered email on lokha.today to auto-authenticate

memberKey.description: Your registered Lokha Member API Key (e.g. 'lokha_...')

membersOnly.description: Whether the article should be paywalled/members only

name: lokha_submit_draft
